text.title: Act II — Into the Redmarsh
text.body: One continuous march from Redmarsh Outpost to the Fork of Spears. Roads link every zone; waypoints let you return.
text.msg.1: Step within the palisades, Commander. The mud of the outer roads clings heavy to your boots. Before you lies Thornwick: the tavern on the left for mercenary blades and whispers, the armory shop in the center for tempered steel, and the academy on the right for runic incantations. Take these silver crowns from the garrison ledger to equip your cohort.
text.win: The roads around Thornwick are safe again.
text.npc.reeve: Raiders choke every mountain pass, and half the garrison is either shivering with marsh fever or drinking away their back pay. Take the tavern contracts on the board, Commander—Thornwick still pays in silver, even if the coins are tarnished by blood.
text.npc.miller: Gnolls broke into the mill at midnight, dragging two sacks of coarse flour into the marsh. If you march eastward toward the border ford, keep your shield tilted high—their barbed horn-bows punch straight through boiled leather.
text.npc.gate_n1: North Gate Salt-Guard: Keep your canteen capped past the alkali ditch.
text.npc.gate_n2: North Gate Lookout: Dust devils mean dune-runners on the ridge.
text.npc.gate_e1: East Gate Caravan-Sentry: Wagons roll at first light for Brine-Well.
text.npc.gate_e2: East Gate Dune-Slinger: Watch the salt-pans for burrower tremors.
text.npc.tanner: Market Tanner: Boiled hides keep peat-leeches off your shins.
text.npc.cooper: Cooper Apprentice: Casks for salt pork and lantern oil, stacked fresh.
text.npc.scribe: Academy Scribe: High Arcanist Vaelen inspects every vitrified shard.
text.npc.bellows: Smithy Bellows-Boy: Master Kaelen keeps the coals white-hot till midnight.
text.npc.carter: Granary Carter: Axle grease costs less than a broken wain in the mud.
text.npc.grave: Orlen the Grave-Tender: Keep the tallow lit by the parish stones.
text.npc.hound: Stable Hound: *Low bark, ears perked toward the east palisade.*
text.npc.fisher: Dockside Fisher: Weir-pikes bite near the old pilings after rain.
text.npc.bram: Quartermaster Bram: Water is four silver a gill, shade is two silver an hour.
text.npc.tull: Cask-Master Tull: Boiled the scorpions out of the cistern before dawn.
text.npc.zahra: Chronicler Zahra: First-Empire wardstones still hum beneath the ochre crust.
text.npc.drover: Caravan Drover: Grease the axles twice in this grit.
text.npc.cistern: Cistern Water-Bearer: Every drop hauled from the deep limestone seam.
text.npc.apprentice: Salt-Scale Apprentice: Counting brass weights and dried jerky.
text.npc.outrider: Outpost Outrider: The Twin Passes shimmer by noon.
text.npc.handler: Mule-Train Handler: Pack-beasts hate the sulfur smell near the quarry.
